_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N354791 (2025-10-28, dev split): CBP held China. Product written by the agent from the facts, no model draft (D823, D826). Target Thailand (where it is finished); plant capabilities for Thailand and all costs are assumptions. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Low-profile steel hydraulic floor jack, 3 ton
product.description: A garage jack: a hydraulic unit on a welded steel frame with a lifting arm, saddle, handle, front wheels and rear casters.

components.name: Pump core, pump cover, cylinder body, piston rod and top cap
Steel side plates, cover plate, brackets and rods
Handle, handle bracket, saddle, front wheels and rear casters

operations.name: Machine the cylinder body, piston rod, pump core and pump cover for the hydraulic unit
Form and weld the lifting arm assembly
Cut the side plates, brackets and rods
Clean the parts and assemble the pump housing, cylinder, piston rod and top cap into the hydraulic unit
Weld the side plates and brackets into the frame, attach the lifting arm and fit the hydraulic unit, casters, handle bracket and saddle
Test, inspect and pack the jacks

economics.duty_rates_note: Illustrative placeholder, not a sourced rate.
